description.narrative: THE PROJECT WILL: (1) FINANCE THE DEVELOPMENT AND CONSERVATION OF MAJOR MAYAN ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES; (2) IMPROVE ROAD ACCESS TO KEY TOURIST AREAS; (3) PROTECT THE BARRIER REEF BY SEEKING SOLUTIIONS TO GROWING PROBLEMS WITH WATER SUPPLY AND SEWAGE TREATMENT ON CAYE CAULKER; (3) INCREASE THE QUANTITY AND QUALITY OF BASIC TOURISM SERVICES THROUGH EMPLOYMENT TRAINING; AND (4) IMPROVE THE EFFECTIVENESS OF KEY INSTITUTIONS IN THE TOURISM SECTOR THROUGH INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING.
